news.title: Google gains 25M subscriptions in Q1, driven by YouTube and Google One
news.description: Google added 25M paid subscriptions in Q1, reaching 350M total, as YouTube and Google One grow.

news.title: Is AI video just a prequel? Runway’s CEO thinks world models are next
news.description: AI-generated video has gone from novelty to creative tool almost overnight, and Runway has a front row seat to the shift. The New York-based company has raised close to $860 million at a $5.3 billion

news.title: Parallel Web Systems hits $2B valuation five months after its last big raise
news.description: The AI agent-tool startup founded by former Twitter CEO Parag Agrawal has raised $100 million, led by Sequoia, months after raising a previous $100 million.

news.title: Google Photos uses AI to make the iconic closet from ‘Clueless’ a reality
news.description: Google says the new feature will leverage AI technology to automatically create a copy of your wardrobe that's based on the pieces of clothing appearing in your Google Photos library.

news.title: Why friendly AI chatbots might be less trustworthy
news.description: Researchers found adjusting AI systems to be more warm and friendly to users would result in an "accuracy trade-off".

news.title: Sanctioned Chinese AI Firm SenseTime Releases Image Model Built for Speed
news.description: With US restrictions limiting its access to advanced tech, SenseTime is doubling down on open source with a new model optimized to run on Chinese-made chips.

news.title: How AI Could Help Combat Antibiotic Resistance
news.description: At WIRED Health, British surgeon Ara Darzi said AI is set to transform the diagnosis and treatment of drug-resistant infections. But a lack of incentives means innovation may not reach patients.

news.title: Why a recent supply-chain attack singled out security firms Checkmarx and Bitwarden
news.description: Security firms find themselves especially exposed.
